meta.title: Rich presence
meta.description: Shows the running agent on your Discord profile: whether it is thinking, running a tool, waiting for approval, or compacting, with the model route and token usage. The large image follows the running model — one each for claude, deepseek, gemini, glm, gpt, grok, kimi, and qwen — with the DSH badge as the small image. Everything is configured on this page — open the bundle to edit, save writes live without a restart. It publishes through a built-in DSH application id, so a fresh install works with no setup; replace it with your own application, or clear it to write the payloads to the log. Tool names and the working-folder name are published by default — turn them off under Privacy to withhold them. Image tooltips need the asset names to match images uploaded to the application in use. Figures fold the session log, so they survive resume, fork, and compaction. Turning the plugin off clears the activity immediately.
